action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Sword or Boulder in any combination.

action.name: Boulder
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Name Sleep {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant falls into a deep, restorative slumber. The giant gains 20 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until it takes damage or the end of its next turn. The giant has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks and saving throws for 1 minute.
